name: Hoisin Sauce
siboNotes: Contains high fructose corn syrup and wheat-based ingredients that can trigger SIBO symptoms. Use sparingly and consider homemade alternatives with low-FODMAP sweeteners.
preparationTips: Dilute with low-sodium soy sauce or rice vinegar to reduce FODMAP load per serving
Use only as a finishing sauce rather than marinade to limit total consumption
Check labels for garlic and onion powder which increase FODMAP content
Store opened bottles refrigerated to maintain flavor and reduce need for larger servings
alternatives: Tamari or soy sauce with maple syrup
Rice wine vinegar with brown sugar
Homemade sauce using garlic-infused oil and maple syrup
Sweet and sour sauce made with low-FODMAP ingredients
pairsWellWith: Bok choy and other Asian greens
nutritionalHighlights: Contains some iron from soybean base
